top_deficiency_types.title: Install emergency lighting that can last at least 1 1/2 hours.

top_deficiency_types.title: Provide a written emergency evacuation plan.

Prevent the use of unnecessary psychotropic medications or use medications that may restrain a resident's ability to function.

top_deficiency_types.title: Provide appropriate care for residents who are continent or incontinent of bowel/bladder, appropriate catheter care,  and appropriate care  to prevent urinary tract infections.
